sinIntro-1.texto: Today we use chat-based coding agents, like Claude Code or Codex,

sinIntro-2.texto: you talk straight to the model,

sinIntro-3.texto: you ask, it answers, you “review” it… and repeat.

sinRamas-1.texto: Then you get a brilliant idea: why not ask for several things at once?

sinRamas-2.texto: You open another session to get ahead on something else.

sinRamas-3.texto: Then another, and another, and another.

sinRamas-4.texto: It seems more efficient, but… you forget something.

sinRamas-5.texto: The model can do a thousand things at once. You can’t.

sinRamas-6.texto: Each new session splits your attention

sinRamas-7.texto: and wastes tokens sending the same context over and over again.

sinRamas-8.texto: You stop reviewing what it hands you, even more,

sinRamas-9.texto: and you start approving on autopilot…

sinRamas-10.texto: In the end you wear yourself out more and spend more, but get less done.

inicio-1.texto: You hand the Studio your project and the goal you want.

inicio-2.texto: The Studio uses its built-in director, which talks to the model for you.

inicio-3.texto: It diagnoses and charts the best route to that goal.

inicio-4.texto: And it gives you strategic missions: one at a time.

inicio-5.texto: Like in a game: with levels, achievements and confetti when you complete one.

trabajo1-2.texto: new ideas, comments or tweaks may come to you.

trabajo1-3.texto: But instead of opening new sessions, you hand them to the Studio.

trabajo1-4.texto: The Studio gathers all your comments and holds them, organized,

trabajo1-5.texto: without sending them to the model yet,

trabajo1-6.texto: freeing your attention so you stay focused on just one thing:

llega1-1.texto: When you feel you have gathered enough ideas, tweaks or comments,

llega1-2.texto: you ask the director for a review.

invoca-1.texto: The Studio hands what is queued to the director.

procesa-1.texto: It assesses the current state, drops what is redundant, checks what helps and what doesn’t,

procesa-2.texto: organizes it and defines a mini execution plan.

procesa-3.texto: Then it uses the model to carry it out in the most efficient way.

reparte-1.texto: When it is done, it reports what it did in a very clear, easy-to-understand way

reparte-2.texto: and sorts your contributions against the plan: what is key becomes a mission.

reparte-3.texto: What does not belong to this phase waits for its own.

reparte-4.texto: What does not help is dropped or rethought, and it tells you why.

entrega-1.texto: So, after each review you get what matters most:

entrega-2.texto: the next most strategic missions, one at a time.

entrega-3.texto: You keep your focus and don’t burn out analyzing ten new fronts at once.

brota-1.texto: And what if an urgent change comes up?

dispara-1.texto: The Studio gives it priority, everything else waits

saleUrg-1.texto: and processes that request right away with the director

devuelveUrg-1.texto: Done: the result of just that request comes back to the Studio,

avisaUrg-1.texto: which gives you, as your next priority mission, checking this result,

avisaUrg-2.texto: before going on with the main flow, without losing focus,

sigue-1.texto: putting you back on the best route.

procesa2-1.texto: the director organizes them into a mini plan and carries it out with the model

reparte2-1.texto: until you reach the goal you set

meta-2.texto: Many ideas, improvements and tweaks processed by the Studio and its director

meta-3.texto: as a single line, consistent and strategic.

meta-4.texto: Less burnout, less cost. That is STL.

globito-3.texto: Sure you want to keep going? Who knows what you’ll find.

globito-5.texto: The goal is behind you. Way behind.

globito-6.texto: Looking for a secret ending? This is it.

globito-8.texto: Now this is scattered attention, huh?

globito-9.texto: Not one more branch around here.

globito-11.texto: How about installing the Studio instead?

globito-12.texto: You can close this now. You have my permission.

globito-13.texto: The timeline needs a rest too.

globito-14.texto: Okay, that’s a lot of seconds.

globito-15.texto: No rush. But there’s nothing here.
